if: recognition of revenue was postponed due to the effect of uncertainties
then: when the uncertainty resolves, the revenue is considered REVENUE OF THE PERIOD IN WHICH IT IS PROPERLY RECOGNISED — not of the earlier period in which it was postponed
note: Postponement moves revenue forward; it does not park it for later back-dating. This closes the loop opened by ACC-REV-POSTPONE-001: without this rule, a resolved uncertainty could be argued into restating the earlier period. AS 9 places it in the later one.
